title: Customers — View and AP/AR show the tiers but no tier fields to change
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as a user whose role (made for this test) has 'Customers — View' and 'View and Manage AP/AR Data' but not 'Customers — Create & Edit'. An Admin makes the records below before the test.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, on tier A for Part Sales.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The card's Pricing section shows Part Sales Tier reading tier A.
  • The page offers no Edit Customer, so the tiers cannot be changed.
